entry.title: [ahmadzeidabad] The Russians' entry is an evil, but...! If Sergei Lavrov, Russia's Foreign…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @ahmadzeidabad

The Russians' entry is an evil, but...! If Sergei Lavrov, Russia's Foreign Minister, is carrying a plan to end the war between America and Iran on his trip to Tehran, the country's decision-makers as a whole ought to welcome it with open arms. I personally had wished that the Russians would be kept out of this conflict and that Iran and America would find a reasonable and balanced path to resolve the hostility themselves. Now that the inability of the two main parties to the conflict to defuse the tension has become evident, the Russians' intervention can be considered an opportunity for diplomacy. The Russians' intervention is, of course, an evil, but compared to the recurrence of war, it is the lesser evil! Therefore, welcoming the lesser evil in the face of the greater evil is what sound reason demands—that is, if any trace of sound reason remains! #احمد_زیدآبادی@ahmadzeidabad

entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @ahmadzeidabad

War and the art of politics! Some influential figures and officials speak so calmly and indifferently about the possibility of war resuming, as if a hand-to-hand war is going to happen or, at most, artillery and mortars will be used on the battlefield! In the third decade of the 21st century, weapons have become so terrifying and destructive that the firing and use of any one of them destroys everything from civilians to all kinds of facilities and the environment, causing destruction and devastation on a vast scale! Precisely for this reason, the art of politics in today's world is to keep the land and nature and society and people away from the ruinous calamity of war.#احمد_زیدآبادی@ahmadzeidabad
